fields.description: Issue features extensive editorial and news commentary on the September 1928 hurricane and flooding disaster in Florida, including conditions in West Palm Beach and the Lake Okeechobee region, relief efforts and criticisms of state response, and communications via radio/telegraph. Includes items on Florida Power & Light Company storm repairs, Red Cross supply delays, and discussion of weather forecasting by Forecaster Gray. Additional local coverage includes Miami Beach municipal election politics, high food prices and cost-of-living complaints in Miami, civic and relief organization activities (including an Elks clothing appeal), and assorted local crime, prohibition-era liquor market notes, and entertainment/society listings and advertisements.
